_why: THE TIE-BREAKER of canon_c195_in12_eager_n2.json: the third run of the 2+1 rule, run ONLY if alignment_check.mjs reads the pair DIVERGENT (exit 2); the config is read as the median of three (pool both sessions in --arm). Same book, same predictions: THE UNDER-SIDE BASE, TAKE 2 (user-ruled 2026-09-15 10:05 local: "more aggressive spend of investment pool money will increase the economy and thus depeasantation. So ceteris paribus, the other parts of the config (A/B/initial input penalty/cost_ladder) should be taken from the side that gave values slightly under the GDP/depeasantation target, not at the target"). Take 1 was C 2.05 x1.2 with the eager set (F121, n=3): BISTABLE - two seeds locked into stalls by early British disasters (0.56 / 0.37x at 1935), one grew to 1.32x with the hoard back at 0.83 of GDP - so C 2.05 is past the cliff (F119 stalled there too, with the x1.3 lift), not "slightly under". This book interpolates on the sweep's own axis: building_cost = anchor x 1.95^era (600 / 1,170 / 2,282 / 4,449 for the 600-point industries; 800 / 1,560 / 3,042 / 5,932 for the 800-point ones) - the top rung 8% dearer than the found slope's 4,115 / 5,487 and 14% cheaper than C 2.05's 5,169 / 6,892 - with the eager-spending define set (MONEY_SPENDING_CONSTRUCTION_TOO_LARGE_INVESTMENT_POOL_FACTOR 0.99 (⚠ 1.0, the cap vanilla's own comment names, is REJECTED by the engine's validator - its range is [0,1) - and the key then keeps VANILLA's 0.75, BELOW the canon's 0.9: landmine L33, found 2026-09-15 at the first run of canon-c19-in12-eager, and it cost F121 one of its four levers. Every unrun eager book was regenerated at 0.99), CRITICAL 1.25, EXCESSIVE 3.0, CONSTRUCTION_MAX_NUM_PRODUCTION_BUILDING_CONSTRUCTIONS_SCALED 0.05; LONG / VERY_LONG 160 / 240), which F121 showed cuts the private backlog to 1.1-1.3 years and the government backlog to 0.9-1.6 in every seed (the found slope: 2.0-2.4 and 2.8-3.0) without holding the pool where growth is. Two changes against canon-c19-in12 (F117 / F120, the found configuration: 1.09 / 1.07 / 1.13 / 1.04x across four seeds, in the band): the slope and the define set; ONE change against canon-c19-in12-eager (the slope) - it runs AFTER that book and is read against it. Full runs unless the stop rule fires.

_register: BATCH 1 OF THE SEQUENCE — cost 1.95 + the eager set, the ruled pairing (the under-side rule). Predictions in the register's terms (end state = the 1932-1936 mean, ratios to vanilla n=16): world GDP 0.95-1.10 (the dearer frontier takes ~0.05-0.10 off the found 1.10, the spent hoard adds some back), the pool's GDP 1.05-1.30 (found 1.30), pool W 0.60-0.72 (found 0.68), pool U* >= 1.8x (found 2.02), pool H 2.0-3.5x vanilla (found 4.2x; the backlog 1.0-1.5 y), world H 1.5-2.5x (found 2.2x), PI 0.80-0.90 (found 0.84), PP 0.80-0.90 (found 0.83), T0 flat or falling, T3 24-30%. HARD: no capital-abundance break expected in two seeds (the hoard half of the pair is what the eager set spends; the found breaks it in 1 of 4). EXPECTED LOSS 3-8 against the incumbent's 7.6, the gain on the two GDP terms (2.05 + 1.42) and the hoard (1.88). BRANCHES (batch 2): world GDP < 0.90 or a stall seed (< 0.75) -> canon-c19-in12-eager (the eager set on the found base); world GDP > 1.15 or the pool's GDP > 1.40 in both seeds -> canon-c20-in12-eager; a hard break, or a read that cannot be attributed to the cost step or the spending step -> canon-c195-in12 (the plain cost step, the one-lever control). THE ADOPT RULE (the loss-minimising iterator, 2026-09-17 evening): the incumbent is canon-c19-in12 at consensus loss 7.6 (F131; its clean seeds 5.3 / 9.5, its soft-line seed 44.4, one seed broken). After the pair (and the tie-breaker on F114 divergence): a HARD break in any run = the config is OUT (one broken run ends it). Otherwise read `criteria.mjs --arm <sessions>:<setup>`: the candidate REPLACES the incumbent only if its consensus loss is below 7.6 by at least 3 (the incumbent's own clean pair differs by 4, so a median of two moves by about 3 on seed noise alone) OR it is better on each of the three largest terms (the pool's GDP, the pool's hoard, world GDP) with no new soft breach; read the PER-SEED losses beside the consensus — a seed that crosses a soft line jumps by 10 x the line's weight, so two seeds at 3 and 40 are not better than two at 5 and 9. Every candidate is launched only on the user's go at the start of the sequence; within the sequence the batches follow each other under the 2+1 rule; at its end the next hypothesis is PROPOSED, not launched.
